text: What if a billion locusts flew over your town?
One desert locust. About two grams.
It eats its own weight every day.
But crowd them together, and they transform!
Green turns yellow and black. They swarm!
A thousand? A buzzing little cloud.
A million? Your garden is gone in a day.
Two thousand tons. Heavier than a thousand cars!
Their cloud: over ten square kilometers.
The sky over your town goes dark.
They eat two thousand tons of food a day.
Food for hundreds of thousands of people!
Riding the wind: 150 kilometers a day.
Real swarms hold hundreds of billions!
So... would you stay inside, or go look?
